COMMAND.name: pppoe-server
COMMAND.help: PPPoE server (mpd5)

COMMAND.name: no pppoe-server
COMMAND.help: Delete ENTIRE configuration PPPoE server (all user + pool)
COMMAND.help-id: Delete SELURUH konfigurasi PPPoE server (all user + pool)

COMMAND.name: exit
COMMAND.help: Back to configure-view

COMMAND.name: end
COMMAND.help: Back to enable-view

COMMAND.name: no
COMMAND.help: Negate a command or set its defaults

COMMAND.name: enable
COMMAND.help: Enable PPPoE server (pending commit)

COMMAND.name: no enable
COMMAND.help: Disable PPPoE server (pending commit)

COMMAND.name: interface
COMMAND.help: Interface on which the PPPoE server listens
COMMAND.help-id: Interface tempat PPPoE server mendengarkan

COMMAND.name: no interface
COMMAND.help: Delete interface PPPoE server

COMMAND.name: pool
COMMAND.help: IP address pool for PPPoE clients (start-end range)
COMMAND.help-id: Pool alamat IP for klien PPPoE (range start-end)

COMMAND.name: no pool
COMMAND.help: Delete PPPoE address pool
COMMAND.help-id: Delete pool alamat PPPoE

COMMAND.name: user
COMMAND.help: PPPoE user (password + optional static IP in the subview)
COMMAND.help-id: User PPPoE (password + IP statis opsional at subview)

COMMAND.name: no user
COMMAND.help: Delete user PPPoE

COMMAND.name: radius-server
COMMAND.help: Server RADIUS for auth PPPoE (without CoA)
COMMAND.help-id: Server RADIUS for auth PPPoE (tanpa CoA)

COMMAND.name: no radius-server
COMMAND.help: Delete server RADIUS (back to auth local)
COMMAND.help-id: Delete server RADIUS (back to auth lokal)

COMMAND.name: radius-secret
COMMAND.help: Shared secret RADIUS (stored in mpd.conf, mode 600)
COMMAND.help-id: Shared secret RADIUS (tersimpan at mpd.conf, mode 600)

COMMAND.name: no radius-secret
COMMAND.help: Delete shared secret RADIUS

COMMAND.name: radius-acct
COMMAND.help: Enable RADIUS accounting PPPoE (sessions appear in myRadDASH)
COMMAND.help-id: Nyalakan RADIUS accounting PPPoE (sesi muncul di myRadDASH)

COMMAND.name: no radius-acct
COMMAND.help: Disable RADIUS accounting PPPoE (default anchor)
COMMAND.help-id: Matikan RADIUS accounting PPPoE (default anchor)

COMMAND.name: radius-nas-ip
COMMAND.help: NAS-IP-Address sent by mpd5 to the RADIUS server (if NATed)
COMMAND.help-id: NAS-IP-Address yang dikirim mpd5 ke server RADIUS (bila di-NAT)

PARAM.name: NasIp
PARAM.help: NAS IPv4 address (AS seen by the RADIUS server)
PARAM.help-id: alamat IPv4 NAS (yang dilihat server RADIUS)

COMMAND.name: no radius-nas-ip
COMMAND.help: Delete the explicit NAS-IP-Address (mpd5 uses the local IP)
COMMAND.help-id: Delete NAS-IP-Address eksplisit (mpd5 pakai IP lokal)

COMMAND.name: console
COMMAND.help: Enable console mpd5 (127.0.0.1:5005, user titian-console)
COMMAND.help-id: Nyalakan console mpd5 (127.0.0.1:5005, user titian-console)

COMMAND.name: console password
COMMAND.help: Regenerate password console mpd5 (16 hex, not shown)
COMMAND.help-id: Regenerasi password console mpd5 (16 hex, tidak ditampilkan)

COMMAND.name: no console
COMMAND.help: Disable console mpd5 (password file also deleted)
COMMAND.help-id: Matikan console mpd5 (password file ikut dihapus)

COMMAND.name: exit
COMMAND.help: Back to PPPoE-server mode
COMMAND.help-id: Back to pppoe-server mode

COMMAND.name: password
COMMAND.help: Password user (stored in mpd.secret, mode 600)
COMMAND.help-id: Password user (tersimpan at mpd.secret, mode 600)

COMMAND.name: ip
COMMAND.help: This IP address static for user (empty = from pool)
COMMAND.help-id: Alamat IP statis for user ini (kosong = from pool)

COMMAND.name: no ip
COMMAND.help: Delete the user's static IP (back to pool)
COMMAND.help-id: Delete IP statis user (back to pool)

COMMAND.name: show pppoe-server
COMMAND.help: PPPoE server status (enable, interface, pool, user count)
COMMAND.help-id: Status PPPoE server (enable, interface, pool, jumlah user)

COMMAND.name: show pppoe-server users
COMMAND.help: PPPoE user list (name + static IP; passwords not shown)
COMMAND.help-id: List user PPPoE (name + IP statis; password not ditampilkan)

COMMAND.name: show pppoe-server sessions
COMMAND.help: Active PPPoE sessions (interface ng*)
COMMAND.help-id: Sesi PPPoE that aktif (interface ng*)

COMMAND.name: pppoe-server
COMMAND.help: PPPoE server operations (disconnect)

COMMAND.name: pppoe-server disconnect
COMMAND.help: Disconnect the active PPPoE session for one user via the mpd5 console (verify the session + close LCP)
COMMAND.help-id: Putus sesi PPPoE aktif untuk satu user via console mpd5 (verifikasi sesi + close LCP)
